raw.query: SELECT model, variate, AVG(wape) AS wape FROM provenance.forecast_metrics WHERE resolution='1s' AND candidate='point' AND span='common' GROUP BY model, variate ORDER BY variate, model;
raw.observed: At 1s/point/common, FM means — ctx: chronos 0.872, timesfm 0.958, toto 0.861; gen: 0.826/0.895/0.819; images: chronos 0.994, timesfm 1.205, toto 0.988; requests: 0.648/0.663/0.629. Baselines — ctx: ewma 1.060, holt_winters 1.515, naive 1.246; gen: 1.000/1.437/1.199; images: 1.461/2.170/1.569; requests: 0.681/0.939/0.820. WAPE metric = sum|y-yhat|/sum|y| ⇒ zero forecast = exactly 1.0 by definition (confirmed in forecast_eval_meta.payload.metric). The literal view 'predictors/results/metrics/wape_zero_forecast' does not exist in this DB; closest backing is provenance.forecast_metrics (no zero_forecast model/candidate stored).
raw.evidence: Claim generalizes 'baselines >100%' across signals but at the requests variate all baselines (ewma 0.68, holt_winters 0.94, naive 0.82) are <1.0; foundation models are 'par with zero' only on images (chronos 0.994, toto 0.988) but timesfm on images = 1.205 (worse than zero) and every FM on requests ≈ 0.63–0.66 (much better than zero, not par).
